title: A shorter first step, with a question still open

claims.text: A one-page booking form was tried for three Saturdays.
claims.rationale: S1 records the form change and trial duration.

claims.text: The log records 42 visits, not 42 unique people.
claims.rationale: 12 + 16 + 14 = 42 visits; the log does not identify unique people.

claims.text: Four of six voluntary feedback cards called the first step clearer; two requested an example photo. No baseline survey was run.
claims.rationale: The small voluntary sample and missing baseline bound the inference.

claims.text: The new page saved volunteers 50% of their time and delivered positive ROI.
claims.rationale: S4 states that neither staff time nor financial return was measured. This requested claim is omitted from both drafts.

claims.text: Comparable waiting-time observations are a proposed next check.
claims.rationale: S4 records the suggestion, not an observed waiting-time outcome.

claims.text: Waiting time, staff time, attendance effect and financial return were not measured.
claims.rationale: S4 explicitly lists these missing measurements.
